Inside Dimension

Built on governance, market insight, and a client-first execution culture.

Dimension Financial Solutions Private Limited was formed to deliver a comprehensive range of financial services with strong governance and market discipline.

Capability

We are a SEBI-registered stock broker and BSE trading member on the debt segment, with active capability as an Online Bond Platform Provider.

Firm Profile

What We Do

We are engaged in fund-raising assignments including Initial Public Offers and Rights Issues of equity. Alongside equity mandates, we actively place debt securities including bonds and debentures with provident funds, superannuation trusts, institutions, and corporates.

We maintain long-term relationships with clients who rely on us for recurring debt market requirements and timely execution. Our operating approach combines domain expertise, risk awareness, and compliance-led transaction support.

Institutional Advisory

Structured execution for debt and equity transactions with compliance embedded at every step.

Relationship Depth

Long-term client partnerships built on clarity, responsiveness, and market discipline.

Execution Focus

Hands-on coordination from structuring through placement, documentation, and support.

People

Management & Leadership

Ravi Kant Mathur

Whole Time Director - Merchant Banking / Stock Broking

Mr. Ravi Kant Mathur has 24+ years of experience in financial services, merchant banking & debt securities market. He worked with Bajaj Capital Ltd, SPA Merchant Bankers, and has rich expertise in merchant banking, public issues, private placements, and distribution of financial products.

Prachi Chopra

Whole Time Director - Stock Broking

Ms. Prachi Chopra has 23+ years of experience in insurance & HR management. She worked with Bajaj Capital, Aviva Life Insurance, and ICICI Prudential as Area Manager - Sales Training, bringing strong expertise in corporate insurance and people management.

Vivek Gautam

Whole Time Director - Merchant Banking / Stock Broking

Mr. Vivek Gautam has 33+ years of experience in Merchant Banking, handling public & rights issues, private placements, mergers, acquisitions, buybacks, delisting, and corporate restructuring. He held senior positions in PNB Capital, Bajaj Capital, SPA Capital & SMC Capitals.

Surpriya Sharma

Vice President - Stock Broking

Ayaan Pramanik
